name: goalscope_a_residual_L40-50_faithfulness
command: mkdir -p logs/goalscope && python -m scripts.evaluation.eval_residual_patchscope --model=Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct --mode faithfulness --alpha 0.1 --source-agg mean --source-layers 40 50 |& tee logs/goalscope/a_residual_L40-50_faithfulness.log
